name: Mara's Cache Optimization
hypothesis: Previous mandatory deposit strategies failed because forcing a return trip after only one item (cargo=1) or two items (cargo=2) resulted in suboptimal load factors and excessive travel distances per food unit harvested. The optimal approach is to delay mandatory deposition until the agent reaches full capacity (cargo=3), allowing them to gather three items before returning home. This maximizes the food-per-trip ratio, ensuring agents utilize their full energy reserves efficiently for maximum harvest volume rather than stopping prematurely due to artificial cargo thresholds.
